The main MAS page identifies 2 Chr. 8:11 as a possible additional Leningrad Codex case whose next chanted word is not initially stressed. MAM has אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אָֽה־אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם, a three-atom compound; this page puts MAM's pointing beside the possible Leningrad Codex interpretation and the two manuscript crops.

Text Pointing of final atom
MAM בָּ֥אָֽה
Possible Leningrad Codex interpretation בָּֽאָ֥ה

In the Leningrad Codex crop, באה could be argued to be pointed בָּֽאָ֥ה (meteg-merkha), in which case the 2 Chronicles 8:11 atom is not a MAS case at all.

Manuscript crops of 2 Chronicles 8:11

The Aleppo Codex crop is included for comparison; the Leningrad Codex crop is the basis for the possible meteg-merkha interpretation.
